verdict.rationale: Perplexity's app store listing advertises a Voice feature ('Instant, up-to-date answers whether you type or say it'), and threads support follow-ups. That shows first-party voice interaction, but nothing documents a natural, real-time, back-and-forth spoken conversation rather than one-off voice queries. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time conversational voice mode, spoken (TTS) responses, interruption/turn-taking behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
